scenarios.title: Broken-link and isolated-file classification
steps: Wait for the startup scan and inspect both business tabs
Toggle expected isolated files and navigate every reported source
Modify one link and confirm the incremental projection equals a clean rebuild
expected: The deterministic fixture reports five broken diagnostics and four default isolated files
Expected periodic isolation is separated from the default count
Markdown, embeds, frontmatter, Canvas, and explicit Bases links contribute the documented edges

scenarios.title: Explicit reference accuracy and bounded rule preview
steps: Open Broken links and inspect all five diagnostics; confirm Ghost, Missing view target, and Not a link are absent
Navigate the Missing folded target and Missing canvas target sources from their diagnostics
Open Link Integrity settings, switch to Isolated files, and preview the Bounded regex expected-isolation rule
Close and reopen settings, confirm the rule remains enabled with the same pattern, then rebuild the index and inspect both business tabs
expected: The initial and rebuilt results contain five broken diagnostics and four default isolated files; excluded formula strings, dynamic prefixes, and fenced Canvas content yield no diagnostic
Bases opens without fabricated link coordinates; Canvas exposes the broken-text-node identifier and its actual text location
The ambiguous regex previews zero matches without freezing; its saved pattern survives reopening, and the preview and naming controls remain usable

scenarios.title: Continuous search and persistent folder expansion
steps: Open the results sidebar and type Missing continuously in search; select and replace part of the query, then clear it
Switch to Isolated files, show expected isolated files, and select the folder tree
Collapse Periodic, search for a nonmatching path, inspect the no-matching-results message, then use Clear search
Rebuild the index and verify that the folder remains collapsed
Switch Broken links to source-folder grouping, expand a source file, search for that source and clear search, then rebuild the index
expected: Search retains focus, the complete typed query, and its selection during result updates
Clear search restores input focus and the first page without changing filters; Periodic remains collapsed after filtering and an index rebuild
Both business tabs and result navigation remain usable
The source file remains expanded after matching search, clearing search and rebuilding the index

scenarios.title: Potential mention discovery, body hints and exact single-link editing
steps: First verify the untouched base fixture still reports five broken and four default isolated files
Explicitly run the acceptance-provider Create potential mention fixtures command; open Mentions Acceptance/Source.md
Use current-note and cursor queries with hints Off; then test Current paragraph and Whole note in editing and reading views
Choose 白云山 same-range targets, 山 contained range and 山南路 crossing range; navigate a target separately from creating a link
Explicitly create one selected link and use immediate Undo; make a later edit and verify conservative Notice Undo refusal
Run reverse lookup for an isolated mention target, cancel a partial scan, and verify stale/read-failure results are never reported as zero
Open CRLF Source.md, navigate from reading/reverse results, create a selected link, then exercise rename/delete, IME, split/popout, touch, keyboard and unload cleanup
expected: Suggestions preserve every range and same-name target while leaving graph and isolation results unchanged until explicit link creation
Off adds no automatic whole-Vault body scan; paragraph selection follows cursor or focused/clicked/touched reading block and viewport fallback
Properties, existing links, code, comments, HTML, math, URLs and tags remain protected
All candidates remain available through paged selection even when viewport decoration is capped
Writing proves current source/editor binding, exact offsets, current target/name and official generated-link resolution; only one ordinary non-embedded link is inserted
Reading mapping failures retain query/navigation; newline conversion is exact, reverse results expose progress/cancellation/completeness, and all runtime hooks detach
